evidence.claim: WAMGROUP produce componenti per la movimentazione di solidi sfusi ed è presente in India con una filiale dal 1996 che fa da hub produttivo.
evidence.quote: The Italian WAMGROUP, worldwide leader in developing and manufacturing equipment and plant components for bulk solids handling and processing, has been represented in India by its own subsidiary since 1996. || Apart from being responsible for distribution of the WAMGROUP product range in India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh and Nepal, WAM India is the Group’s manufacturing hub for the subcontinent. || Feed & Food Battery Plastics & Chemicals Building & Construction Animal Nutrition
